QuestInfo.name: [Valentine's Day] Gift Shop Grand Opening
QuestInfo.0: Ace of Hearts's Valentine's Day gift shop has opened!
QuestInfo.1: Earn Candy Points when you hunt monsters, then use those to buy an awesome Valentine's Day gift from Ace of Hearts's gift shop.
QuestInfo.2: Candy Point can be used to trade for an awesome gift in the Valentine's Day gift shop operated by Ace of Hearts.
